answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 38182 Country: India Title: Islamic Names Question: Please let me know the meaning of the following names: 1. Rubeena 2. Farzana Answer ID: 38182 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 715/587/B=1433) We do not know the meaning of Rubeena, but Farzana means: intelligent, wise and clever. This is good for name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
